subject: Cloud Orchestra consulting: Onramp & activation plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orion-consulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cloud Orchestra consulting: Onramp & activation plan

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. We’re excited to get Cloud Orchestra certified to deliver Redwood-powered integrations. I put together a first-cut activation plan (attached) that splits the onboarding into three discrete sprints: environment & access, solution lab (joint build), and partner enablement + certification.

Key asks from your side before sprint 1:
- Confirm 2 engineers for the initial integration sprint (one infra lead, one app dev)
- Provide sandbox AWS account info or short-term credentials (see attachment for least-privilege template)
- Pick preferred workshop dates (we recommend a 3-day hands-on block + 1 follow-up day)

We’d like to run the first workshop the week of Dec 7 — does that work? Laura will own logistics and Ben will run the technical lab.

Attachments: COC-Workshop-Agenda-v1.pdf, cloudoorchestra-aws-access-README.txt

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orion-consulting.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@infrapulse.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud Orchestra consulting: Onramp & activation plan

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the clear plan. We can commit two engineers: Mira Singh (infra) and Daniel Ortiz (app). Dec 7 week looks good for the workshop. We’ll send temporary sandbox credentials by EOD Wednesday — note that our security team will want the least-privilege template filled out.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you share the pre-workshop checklist so our team can prepare sample prompts and dataset slices?
2) Will the session include a short module on Redwood’s routing/fallback policies? That’s a key ask for our systems integrators.

We’ll also loop in our sales engineering lead (Tom) for the kickoff.

Best,
Priya Shah
Partner Lead, Cloud Orchestra Consulting
priya.shah@orion-consulting.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orion-consulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud Orchestra consulting: Onramp & activation plan

Thanks Priya — that’s great. Quick answers inline: 

- Pre-workshop checklist: attached as part of the activation checklist spreadsheet (SI-Activation-Checklist.xlsx). It includes prompt samples, API key request flow, and recommended test corpora.
- Routing/fallback module: yes — Ben will include a 45-minute deep-dive on routing policies, model variant selection, and cost-performance tradeoffs. We’ll cover a simple policy you can reuse in client deployments.

Logistics / next steps:
- Please send sandbox creds to the secure inbox link in the README (cloudoorchestra-aws-access-README.txt).
- Ben: can you draft the lab curriculum and send by Wed EOD?
- Laura: I’ll need the calendar invite + conference bridge created once we lock the workshop dates.

Naomi

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@orion-consulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud Orchestra consulting: Onramp & activation plan — draft lab curriculum

Hi all —

Attached is a concise lab curriculum and timing for the 3-day workshop. High level:
Day 1 — Environment & access (IAM + sandbox setup, test data import, inference smoke tests)
Day 2 — Integrations & ops (streaming responses, KV cache patterns, quantization options)
Day 3 — Partner delivery patterns (mutual-action playbook + sample client migration runbook)
Follow-up — 1 day remote Q&A + certification exam (practical lab).

I included exercises with expected outcomes and time-boxed checkpoints. Sample deliverables we’ll ask Cloud Orchestra to produce during the lab:
- Reference integration repo (starter templates)
- 2x short runbooks: deployment and rollback
- A simple benchmarking report (latency & cost per token for 3 prompt patterns)

Attachments: SI-Activation-Checklist.xlsx (tab: Curriculum), COC-Workshop-Agenda-v1.pdf

Priya — confirm if you want us to swap any lab modules or add a joint sales-play session.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Partner Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@infrapulse.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@orion-consulting.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud Orchestra consulting: Onramp & activation plan — confirm workshop and security note

Hi team —

All good on our side for Dec 8–10 (Priya suggested week of Dec 7; we need the 8–10 block). We’ll send the sandbox IAM principal tonight using the template; please confirm we should use the role name "coc-onramp-lab".

Security note: our CISO asks that session recordings be stored in our S3 bucket (temporary, encrypted) and retention be limited to 30 days. Please confirm Redwood’s retention policy for recordings and any logs captured during the lab.

Looking forward to working together.

Tom Reynolds
Sales Engineering, InfraPulse (Cloud Orchestra partner)
